headline: Olavi's Wake and Pari Peak Flare as Central Sectors Contested
war_summary: Fierce fighting has suddenly erupted across the theater's newer flashpoints, with Olavi's Wake exploding into intense clashes over Iltaku and Kulkue, yielding eight base shifts and nearly three thousand casualties in the past two hours alone. Nearby Pari Peak caught fire in tandem, marking six quick conversions around Pariah and Itään. Meanwhile, the central cauldron in The Gutter and Weathered Expanse refuses to abate; The Gutter recorded seven fresh base turnovers across Kuoppa and The Parras, while Weathered Expanse suffered over three thousand additional casualties as Spirit Watch and Frostmarch remained bitterly contested. At Stlican Shelf, renewed assaults against Breaker Town produced two recent exchanges amidst accelerating attrition. In contrast, earlier conversion hotbeds in Nevish Line, Palantine Berm, and Linn of Mercy have quieted over the last two hours, while Marban Hollow logged only isolated skirmishing. Heavy combat and soaring body counts nonetheless persist along Farranac Coast, Callahan's Passage, and Stonecradle, keeping the broader frontlines under relentless pressure.
